## Problem Statement
Is your feature request related to a problem? A clear and concise description of what the problem is.
*Example: I find it frustrating when I want to track physical collector editions that came with merchandise...*

## Proposed Solution
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen and how the user experience should work.

## Alternative Solutions Considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Privacy & Data Sovereignty Alignment
Lycoris is strictly offline-first, telemetry-free, and sovereign. Does this proposed feature respect these core principles?
- [ ] Yes, this feature operates locally on-device without requiring centralized servers or user tracking.
- [ ] This feature involves network requests (please explain below).

## Mockups / Additional Context
Add any other context, sketches, mockups, or screenshots about the feature request here.
